# Maximize Your Tech, LLC

> Deaf-owned technology, delivery, event access, fabrication, and custom computer shop in Philomath, Oregon, serving Corvallis, Albany, Portland, and the Willamette Valley.

## Core Services

- [Tech Delivery & Setup](https://maximizeyourtech.com/delivery.html): Store-to-door electronics delivery from Best Buy, Fred Meyer, Target, Walmart, and local retailers. Standard delivery for TVs up to 55" and electronics ($45 + mileage); truck delivery for 55"+ TVs and oversized gear ($95 + mileage); onsite assembly and mounting ($60/hour).
- [Computers & Woojer Vest](https://maximizeyourtech.com/computers.html): Custom computer builds and upgrades from published parts lists. Entry, mid-range ($1,000–$1,800), and high-end rigs, plus hardware upgrades ($50–$100+). Authorized partner for the Woojer Vest 4 ($407).
- [Event Access](https://maximizeyourtech.com/access.html): Live room captioning on room displays, live stream production with video switching and recording, and post-event captioned video files. Rates from $60/hour, or $0.80/minute for video files.
- [Made Goods](https://maximizeyourtech.com/goods.html): Custom vinyl markings, heat-pressed hats and mugs, 3D printing (medium up to 6×6", large up to 12×12"), and laser engraving. Published labor rate $25/hour.
- [Work Portfolio](https://maximizeyourtech.com/work.html): Real-world client case studies, including CodaFest 2026 at Camp Taloali (captions on room screens and YouTube broadcast).
- [About Us](https://maximizeyourtech.com/about.html): Background on owner Mayan Fogarty (certified systems administrator) and Susan (client accounts & sales). Deaf-owned and community-partnered with CymaSpace arts accessibility nonprofit.
- [Request a Quote](https://maximizeyourtech.com/contact.html): Quote request form and direct contact details.
